author: GamingBolt
description:
It’s a little bittersweet to learn that there’s still a lot of Resident Evil left for us to enjoy, but that the journey we’ve been on for so many years is may be heading towards an end, as per a developer interview with Yahoo Japan (via IGN). 

Of course, we went down a rabbit hole of possibilities before we collected our thoughts enough to talk about what a conclusion to Resident Evil could look like. We enjoyed putting this one together, and we’re quite sure you’re going to enjoy watching it as much as we did.
title: Resident Evil's Story Could End In The Next 10 Years - What Does That Actually Mean?

author: GamingBolt
description:
So you're playing a difficult game, and the inevitable happened – you died. Again. It's not surprising because some titles are built that way, but the words “You died” really get to me. Over the years, many have invented their own interpretations. Dark Souls as an analogy for overcoming one's depression? “You tried,” some would say, and that's completely valid. 

For others, however, the defeat stings all the more because you know what happened. “You should probably play something else,” the list goes on, even if that's not the intention. Because the words ultimately don't matter as much as what they reflect: Failure.
title: This Is Phantom Blade Zero's BIGGEST Strength

author: GamingBolt
description:
From orchestrating increasingly elaborate getaways to exploiting Leonida's wildlife, Grand Theft Auto VI has the potential to deliver some wonderfully chaotic open-world escapades. Rockstar's previous games have already given us plenty of reasons to dream big, and with Vice City and the surrounding state providing the backdrop, there are countless possibilities to imagine, however, with some arguably more ambitious than others. 

Whether it's provoking an all-out gang war, turning a superyacht into a criminal hideout, or watching my own misadventures go viral, these are ten things I can't wait to try when I finally step foot in Leonida’s open world.

All details and footage referenced in this video are sourced directly from officially revealed information. This video is a wishlist of personal expectations for GTA VI.

Thumbnail credit: Rockstar Games, Edge Magazine, GamesRadar via VICE.
title: Grand Theft Auto 6 - 10 Crazy Ways I Want to Push Its Open World

author: GamingBolt
description:
Even with 66 days left to live, Soul's journey is pretty harsh in Phantom Blade Zero. Whether it's enemies attacking simultaneously and without mercy, increasingly challenging bosses, or fast-paced combat where anticipation is as important (if not more so) as reaction, surviving in the Wulin can be surprisingly difficult.

Thankfully, plenty of strategies abound, whether it's playing stealthily, finding more materials to upgrade your weapons to higher levels or taking advantage of Power Surges and weapon switching.
title: Phantom Blade Zero - 15 Things I WISH I Knew Before Playing
